title: Starlight Bastion
description: Defend a luminous crystal against five waves of voxel invaders. Move, aim and hold the line; between waves, choose the upgrade that keeps your small world alive.
controls: WASD / arrows move · Mouse aims + hold click fires · Space auto-aims + fires · Touch: drag to move + auto-fire · FIRE button auto-aims · 1–3 choose upgrades · P / Esc pause · R restart

zh-CN.title: 星辉堡垒
zh-CN.description: 守护发光的晶核，击退五波体素敌人。边移动边瞄准射击，每波结束后选择升级，让这座小小的堡垒继续闪耀。
zh-CN.controls: WASD / 方向键移动 · 鼠标瞄准并按住左键射击 · 空格自动瞄准射击 · 触屏拖动移动并自动开火 · FIRE 按钮自动瞄准射击 · 1–3 选择升级 · P / Esc 暂停 · R 重开
